question.text: A first-time sponsor, Mr. Kiran Joshi, is applying to SEBI for AIF registration. Which of the following is a mandatory eligibility requirement applicable to the Sponsor?

answer.text: Must be a person/entity satisfying 'fit and proper' criteria specified in Schedule II of the SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008; and must be responsible for formation & registration of the AIF
Must be a listed entity with market cap exceeding INR 1000 crore
Must have personally managed at least INR 500 crore in a regulated AMC for 10 years
Must be an SEBI-registered Merchant Banker in its own right

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, the Sponsor is the person or entity responsible for the formation and registration of the AIF with SEBI, and the Sponsor must satisfy the fit-and-proper criteria specified in Schedule II of the SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008. The Sponsor can be any person or persons, including institutions or companies. The Trap: The market-cap option invents a listing/size requirement that is not in the source. The AUM-track-record option fabricates a Manager-style qualification and applies it to the Sponsor. The merchant-banker option confuses the Sponsor role with the independent Merchant Banker that handles PPM due diligence. Note: The Sponsor and the Manager are distinct roles in the SEBI AIF framework; an individual can serve as Sponsor without prior AMC management experience.
